Write a reply from Jonas Weber declining an invitation to speak at a conference on 12 March, because he will be travelling.
Limits: at most 90 words. The first line must be 'Dear Ms Albrecht,'. Thank her, say clearly that he cannot attend, mention the date, and offer an alternative: a later event or a colleague who could speak.
Answer with the reply only.

arguments.answer:
Dear Ms Albrecht,

Thank you very much for inviting me to speak at your conference on 12 March. I am honoured to be asked, but unfortunately I cannot attend, as I will be travelling on that date.

I would be glad to take part in a later event. If you would like a speaker for March, my colleague Dr Lena Hoffmann knows the subject well and may be available. I would be happy to put you in touch.

Thank you again for thinking of me.

Kind regards,
Jonas Weber
